ticket.title: Urgent: Login Failures and MFA Issues in Production (APAC)
ticket.description: We are experiencing significant issues with the SSO Integration Module in our production environment across the APAC region. As of this morning, approximately 879 users are unable to log in. The symptoms include login failures where credentials are rejected, MFA codes being marked as invalid despite being correct, and password reset emails not being received. This is severely impacting our operations.

candidates.RC40: insufficient information to determine root cause
